en: Black‑and‑white landscape view taken from a field outside a small European town. In the middle distance stands a large church with two slender Gothic spires dominating the skyline. Around it are compact townhouses, factory chimneys, and tree‑lined streets. Low hills rise in the far background, including a solitary conical hill. The foreground consists of cultivated fields and a rural dirt road lined with trees. No visible caption or writing appears on the image side.
